headline: First real, statistically decisive win over the live submission found this session. kangaskhan_crustle + heuristic beats lucario_fighting + heuristic 60.7% (CI [52.7%, 68.1%]), found via MAP-Elites/Double-Oracle population search, not more training. Submission rebuilt and self-verified.

widened_data_pull.note: Added a per-file download timeout (60s) after Week 5's pull stalled indefinitely on a hung network call with no way to notice from outside. This run had only 1 error total vs. the prior total stall -- the fix worked.

self_play_refinement.method: Reused Week 2's PFSP + frozen-teacher-KL machinery unchanged, pointed at rocket_mewtwo and seeded from bc_rocket_mewtwo.pt -- proving the self-play architecture was already deck-agnostic, not rebuilt for this archetype.
self_play_refinement.honest_verdict: The improvement did NOT transfer to the matchup that matters -- essentially unchanged (29-33%) from before self-play. Root cause: the self-play league only ever played rocket_mewtwo against opponents piloting the same deck (itself, past selves, generic baselines), never against lucario_fighting's ecosystem. Improving relative to your own lineage does not guarantee generalizing to an opponent that was never part of training.

spr_lite_auxiliary_loss.status: built and unit-tested (14/14 test_week7.py tests pass), not run through a full retraining+bench ablation this pass
spr_lite_auxiliary_loss.reason: Time was redirected to capitalize on the MAP-Elites finding once it produced a real, decisive win -- a higher-confidence lever than an unproven auxiliary loss. SPR remains real, working, backward-compatible architecture (opt-in via --use-spr, existing checkpoints unaffected) ready for a future pass.
spr_lite_auxiliary_loss.implementation: DynamicsHead predicts next-decision trunk embedding from current trunk + chosen action features, trained BYOL-style (stop-gradient target, no negative samples needed) against the true next decision within the same trace file (ptcg/train/dataset.py's load_paired_records).

map_elites_double_oracle.seed_source: All real decklists captured from the live ladder this session (Weeks 4-5's pull), each the highest-real-leaderboard-rank example available -- not invented.
map_elites_double_oracle.key_finding: seed:kangaskhan has worst-case 0.4125 (vs Crustle wall) using the unmodified existing heuristic -- the best worst-case found by ANY deck this entire session, including every patched/mutated lucario_fighting and rocket_mewtwo variant.
map_elites_double_oracle.double_oracle_equilibrium: ~78% combined weight on Kangaskhan-lineage decks (kangaskhan:r0 50.7% + seed:kangaskhan 26.4% + kangaskhan:r0 22.9%), 0% on all Dragapult variants and rocket_mewtwo.
map_elites_double_oracle.novel_design_detail: The real Kangaskhan decklist runs Crustle itself (4 copies) alongside Mega Kangaskhan ex -- answering the ex-counter problem directly (play both the win condition and the counter to what counters it) rather than avoiding it, a technique no local single-deck search this session would have found.

kangaskhan_crustle_decisive_bench.policy: unmodified existing heuristic, no new training

vs_crustle_wall.note: still loses to a dedicated ex-counter wall deck, but far better than lucario_fighting's own 2-11% there

strategy_notebook.status: fully validated end-to-end against real data, includes the complete narrative through this finding
